hypothesis: The number of guide RNA molecules required for Cas9 to cut a specific DNA sequence is inversely proportional to the length of the target sequence.
prediction: Cas9 will require fewer guide RNA molecules to cut a 20-base pair target sequence compared to a 10-base pair target sequence.
measurement_method: Compare the minimum number of guide RNA molecules needed to achieve detectable DNA cutting in vitro for 20-bp vs. 10-bp target sequences using gel electrophoresis.
falsification_condition: If the number of guide RNA molecules required for cutting the 20-bp target is not at least 1.33 times greater than for the 10-bp target.
